content.comment_body: 1.5 What's new in [product_name]? 1.5.1 What is new in [product_name] [version_no]? The features listed below apply exclusively to [product_name] [version_no]. New features include: • Addition of a new device type in network project mode: [product_name] [version_no] device and slave device. • New hardware types in diagram mode: [product_name] [version_no] device and slave device. • Cloud integration: Support for connecting the base module to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud and syncing data with AWS Cloud. • Certificate management: Capability to review and update certificate details. • Enhanced security options: – Updated access control settings including status display and differentiated web user/guest access. – Encryption of circuit diagrams and network projects saved in [product_name] [version_no] and later releases. – HTTPS protocol support. • Online testing for operator devices. • Improved message text settings supporting additional character sets. • Zoom feature to adjust text and icon size in [product_name]. • Updated message text function block allowing parameter copy/paste within the same diagram. • Multi-line function lets users select and connect multiple lines to a block. • Ethernet configuration relocated to the general settings tab. • Eastern character support for IO status names. • Option to install editor tool together with [product_name] [version_no].
When will the update be available for download?
